conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Hey there! I'm doing great, thanks for asking. How can I help you today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'm doing well too! I was hoping you could tell me how to set up a new smart home device.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great! First, ensure your device is powered on and your smartphone or tablet is connected to the same Wi-Fi network. Then, download the device's specific app from your app store.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Okay, so once I download the app, what's the next step?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Once in the app, you'll typically be guided through adding a new device and connecting it to your home network. Follow the on-screen prompts to complete the setup.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: What kind of prompts should I expect?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: You'll likely see prompts to select your device type, enter your Wi-Fi password, and possibly scan a QR code on the device itself. Some devices might also ask you to press a button on them to put them in pairing mode.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For example, a smart plug might ask you to confirm its blinking light, while a smart speaker might prompt you to speak a command to confirm connection.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's really helpful, thank you for explaining all of that! I appreciate the clear steps.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help you get started with your smart home device. Have a great day!
